---
title: "02 Normalization, feature selection and clustering"
output: html_document
---
This notebook performs:
  - Library-size log normalization,
  - selection of highly variable genes (HVGs) with batch blocking, 
  - HVG principal components, and 
  - graph-based clustering

Data are not integrated or batch-corrected. Sequencing batch is used only as a blocking factor when modelling gene variance.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(scuttle)
  library(scran)
  library(scater)
  library(igraph)
})
source(file.path("..", "R", "helpers.R"))
paths <- load_paths()
```

## Parameters

```{r parameters}
n_hvg          <- 2000
hvg_pca_dims   <- 13  
block_field    <- "Seq_batch"
mito_pattern   <- "^MT-"
ribo_pattern   <- "^RP[SL]"
snn_k          <- 20
leiden_res     <- c(1.0, 0.8)
leiden_seed    <- 1

# Sex-chromosome genes are taken from Ensembl BioMart (release 116 archive)
biomart_host    <- "https://jun2026.archive.ensembl.org"
biomart_dataset <- "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"
sex_chromosomes <- c("X", "Y", "chrX", "chrY", "CHR_X", "CHR_Y", "chr_X", "chr_Y")
```

```{r load}
sce <- readRDS(file.path(paths$work_dir, "01_qc_filtered.rds"))
dim(sce)
```

## Normalization

`logcounts = log2(counts / size factor + 1)`, using library-size factors (`size.factors = NULL`).

```{r normalize}
sce <- scuttle::logNormCounts(sce, transform = "log", size.factors = NULL,
                              name = "logcounts")
summary(sizeFactors(sce))
```

## Highly variable genes

Gene variance is modelled with sequencing batch as a blocking factor. 
Mitochondrial, ribosomal and sex-chromosome genes are excluded from the HVG selection

```{r sex-genes}
query <- paste0(
  '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE Query>',
  '<Query virtualSchemaName="default" formatter="TSV" header="1" uniqueRows="1" ',
  'count="" datasetConfigVersion="0.6">',
  '<Dataset name="', biomart_dataset, '" interface="default">',
  '<Attribute name="external_gene_name"/><Attribute name="chromosome_name"/>',
  '</Dataset></Query>')
bm <- utils::read.delim(
  paste0(biomart_host, "/biomart/martservice?query=",
         utils::URLencode(query, reserved = TRUE)),
  header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
names(bm) <- c("external_gene_name", "chromosome_name")
sexchr_genes <- unique(bm$external_gene_name[bm$chromosome_name %in% sex_chromosomes])

is_sex  <- as.character(rowData(sce)$symbol) %in% sexchr_genes
is_mito <- grepl(mito_pattern, rownames(sce))
is_ribo <- grepl(ribo_pattern, rownames(sce))
c(sex = sum(is_sex), mito = sum(is_mito), ribo = sum(is_ribo))

save_tsv(data.frame(gene_id = rownames(sce), is_sex = is_sex),
         file.path(paths$work_dir, "02_sex_chromosome_flags.tsv"))
```

```{r hvg}
dec <- scran::modelGeneVar(sce, assay.type = "logcounts",
                           block = as.character(sce[[block_field]]))
dec_df <- as.data.frame(dec, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(rownames(dec_df), rownames(sce)))

eligible <- !(is_mito | is_ribo | is_sex) & is.finite(dec_df$bio) & is.finite(dec_df$total)
hvgs <- as.character(scran::getTopHVGs(dec_df[eligible, , drop = FALSE], n = n_hvg))
stopifnot(length(hvgs) == n_hvg)
```

## Dimensionality reduction

PCA is performed on the scaled logcounts of the 2,000 HVGs with  `calculatePCA` using the default solver (randomized IRLBA). 

```{r pca}
set.seed(1)
hvg_pca <- scater::calculatePCA(sce, subset_row = hvgs, ncomponents = hvg_pca_dims,
                                exprs_values = "logcounts", scale = TRUE)
hvg_pca <- as.matrix(hvg_pca)[colnames(sce), , drop = FALSE]
colnames(hvg_pca) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(hvg_pca_dims))
reducedDim(sce, "hvg_pca") <- hvg_pca
```

## Clustering

Shared-nearest-neighbour graph is constructed on the HVG PCs, followed by Leiden clustering.

```{r cluster}
graph <- scran::buildSNNGraph(t(hvg_pca), k = snn_k)
for (r in leiden_res) {
  set.seed(leiden_seed)
  field <- paste0("cluster_hvg_res", sub("\\.0$", "", format(r)))
  colData(sce)[[field]] <- as.character(
    igraph::cluster_leiden(graph, resolution_parameter = r)$membership)
}
table(sce$cluster_hvg_res1)
```

## Verify against the deposited object

In the deposited object, `cluster_hvg_res1` is stored as `final_cluster`.

```{r verify}
ann <- readRDS(file.path(paths$zenodo_root, "RDS", "filtered_annotated_object.rds"))
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(assay(sce, "logcounts"), assay(ann, "logcounts"), check.attributes = FALSE)),
  max(abs(abs(reducedDim(sce, "hvg_pca")) - abs(reducedDim(ann, "hvg_pca")))) < 1e-2,
  identical(sce$cluster_hvg_res1, as.character(ann$final_cluster)),
  identical(sce$cluster_hvg_res0.8, as.character(ann$cluster_hvg_res0.8)))
rm(ann)
```

```{r save}
saveRDS(sce, file.path(paths$work_dir, "02_clustered.rds"))
sessionInfo()
```
